name: opening_drive_post_gap_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, overnight gaps >0.3% are driven by FII flows, US market close, and macro news absorbed after the Indian close. The first 5 minutes (09:15-09:20) serve as the price discovery window where pre-open auction imbalances resolve into live orders. When this discovery window closes in the same direction as the gap — confirmed by a strong candle body (>55% body/range ratio) and above-average volume — institutional VWAP/TWAP algorithms have committed to directional orders that are only 20-30% filled at 09:20. The residual unfilled institutional demand continues pushing NIFTY 10-20 spot points in the same direction for the next 30-120 seconds, creating a high-probability window for ATM CE/PE entry at exactly 09:20 IST.
session: 09:20-09:22 IST (signal fires once at first 5-min close, hold 30-120s)

indicators.name: gap_pct
indicators.purpose: Identifies overnight FII/macro-driven directional bias. Requires one prior trading day only — the gap is a single day-boundary comparison, not a rolling window. Threshold 0.3% chosen to exclude noise-driven intraday gaps and focus on structurally meaningful overnight repositioning.

indicators.name: first_5min_drive
indicators.purpose: FIXED TIME WINDOW: 09:15-09:20 = exactly 60 bars at 5s frequency. NOT scaled from original 1-min bars — it is the same 5-minute window regardless of bar size. This window captures the resolution of pre-open order book imbalances and confirms whether institutional order flow is aligned with the gap direction.

indicators.name: first_5min_body_ratio
indicators.purpose: Candle body strength of the first 5-minute window. Ratio >0.55 confirms directional conviction — a doji or spinning top in the first 5 min suggests price discovery is unresolved and the drive thesis is invalid. Replaces the original 'close in upper/lower 25% of range' confirmation.

indicators.name: vol_surge_ratio
indicators.purpose: 5-day rolling average of first-5-min volume as baseline. 5 days chosen as minimum stable baseline — shorter windows are too noisy at the open, longer windows dilute recent structural changes in market participation. Surge ratio >1.5x confirms genuine institutional order flow, not mechanical market-maker hedging.

conditions: first_5min_drive == +1 (close > open of first 5-min window, drive aligned with gap)
time_minutes == 560 (exactly at 09:20 IST, first bar after 5-min close)
buy_ce.confirmation: All conditions met simultaneously at the single daily entry bar

conditions: first_5min_drive == -1 (close < open of first 5-min window, drive aligned with gap)
buy_pe.confirmation: All conditions met simultaneously at the single daily entry bar

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points = ~8 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. If a gap-aligned institutional drive reverses 8 spot points within the first 120 seconds, the VWAP/TWAP order flow thesis has failed — algo orders were absorbed or cancelled. NIFTY's typical 30-second range is 2-5 pts; a 4-pt stop allows for normal noise while cutting a genuinely failed drive.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option points = ~14 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. Opening drive continuations on NIFTY after gap-aligned first-5-min closes historically push 15-25 spot points in the next 60-120 seconds as residual institutional orders execute. 7 pts captures the conservative lower bound of this range at 1:1.75 R:R.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 09:22 IST (1:1.75 R:R or time stop, whichever comes first)

filters.vix_filter: none — VIX level does not materially alter institutional order flow behavior at the open
filters.time_filter: signal fires only at time_minutes == 560 (09:20 IST); no re-entries intraday
filters.volume_filter: first_5min volume > 1.5x rolling 5-day average first-5-min volume
filters.trend_filter: drive direction must match gap direction (alignment check built into logic)
filters.spread_filter: not applicable — limit orders at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — opening drive dynamics are structural: institutional VWAP algo behavior at market open is consistent across market regimes. Risk is reduced participation on expiry days.

adaptation_notes: Original strategy traded individual NIFTY50 stocks with cross-sectional stock selection and spread filtering. Converted to trade NIFTY index directly: (1) gap_pct now computed on NIFTY index open vs prior day's index close, not individual stocks; (2) first_5min_drive computed on index candle, which is smoother and less gappy than single stocks; (3) volume surge uses rolling 5-day avg of index first-5-min volume (more stable baseline than stock-specific volumes); (4) bar_body_ratio simplified from original's 'close in upper/lower 25% of range' to body/range ratio (equivalent but cleaner for 5-second aggregated window); (5) hold time compressed from 10-40 min to 30-120 seconds — we are not riding the full institutional order completion but only the first momentum burst where unfilled orders create a predictable 30-120 second continuation.
weaknesses: Signal fires only once per day — low trade frequency reduces statistical confidence in backtests
On expiry days (Thursday for NIFTY), opening drive dynamics can be distorted by hedging unwinds and morning volatility spikes, reducing edge
Gap detection using index open vs prev close can be noisy on days with pre-market futures gyrations that partially normalize before cash open
Volume surge filter effectiveness depends on having at least 5 prior trading days in the DataFrame — cold-start problem at beginning of backtest window

_source.original_stop: 0.5 * ATR_10 or reversal to opposite end of first 5-min range
_source.original_target: 0.5% move from entry in drive direction
